text_block_list.text:
—That day, Winning Ticket was wandering 
along the riverbank all by herself...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why am I on the riverbank!? Someone tell 
meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Not like anyone's gonna answer me, 
though. *sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I remember spotting a grandma who looked 
lost in front of the station—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's what comes after that~! The problem 
is after guiding them to the destination!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"All I did was walk straight back the way 
I came, so how in the world did I end up 
at a riverbank?!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm the one who's completely and 
utterly looooost?!

By the time an utterly exhausted Winning 
Ticket finally made it back to the 
academy, the sun had already completely 
set—
